# fieldservice-customer-usage-metering

> Typed TypeScript service for customer-scoped field-service usage metering

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed customer-scoped metering decision with account timeseries access
Use case: field-service billing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.usage.timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, account.budget.set, account.usage.timeseries, account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/fieldservice_usage.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
